cim: Who Reaps the Gains from Artificial Intelligence?...
cim_eredeti: Who Reaps the Gains from Artificial Intelligence?...
szoveg_eredeti: A company may double its output without hiring a single additional worker. A service provider may deliver its services with half its staff. By the measure of efficiency, this looks like an achievement. Yet it raises a broader development question: how does higher productivity translate into more jobs and better incomes? In the Global South, including Jordan, where labour markets struggle to absorb growing numbers of young people, this question is central to assessing the effects of technological change.
